files.name: Main.bas
files.text:
' ATTACK OF THE CYBORG UNICORNS - for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Giant cyborg unicorns are marching across the neon plain to the gate at its far left end. Fly
' your jet over them and shoot them down - each takes a lot of shooting, and goes from silver to
' pink to orange to red as it breaks up. They fire bolts from their horns. If one walks through
' the gate you lose a ship. Clear a wave and a bigger, faster one comes.
'
' Keys: Q A O P, or S X Z C, or the cursor keys (5 6 7 8): fly. Left / right turns the jet and
'       speeds it up that way. Space (or M, or Kempston fire): fire (hold it down).
'
' The landscape is one Layer 2 picture the hardware scrolls round (Scene.cls); the jet, the
' unicorns (4 sprites each, drawn twice the size) and the explosions are sprites; the bolts and
' shots are moved and checked in Z80 (Bul.cls); the HUD and the scanner are the tilemap, the
' scanner's dots sprites; the sound is the AY.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const WORLD = 2048                       ' the plain is 2048 pixels long (8 screens)
Const NU = 7, NB = 8
' sprite slots (Bul has 50-127)
Const SP_SHIP = 0, SP_UNI = 1, SP_BOOM = 33, SP_WIN = 41, SP_DOTME = 42, SP_DOTU = 43
' where the jet can go (paper coordinates)
Const YTOP = 44, YLOW = 160

Dim longText As String Max 80
' the unicorns: on, x (8ths of a pixel over the plain), life, its most, how fast (8ths a frame),
' when it fires next, a hit flash
Dim uon(6) As Integer, ux(6) As Integer, uhp(6) As Integer, umax(6) As Integer, uspd(6) As Integer, ufire(6) As Integer, ufl(6) As Integer
Dim uy As Integer
' explosions: x over the plain, y, time, big
Dim bx(7) As Integer, by(7) As Integer, bt(7) As Integer, bbig(7) As Integer, bnext As Integer
' the jet: x (8ths of a pixel over the plain), y, speed (8ths a frame), facing (1 right, -1 left)
Dim sx As Integer, sy As Integer, svx As Integer, face As Integer, alive As Integer, inv As Integer, deadT As Integer, cool As Integer
Dim camX As Integer, pan As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, lives As Integer, wave As Integer, remain As Integer, over As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, msgT As Integer, scoreDirty As Integer, clearT As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Scene.Init
Bul.Init GfxData.S_SHOT
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL                    ' sprites over the HUD, the HUD over the landscape
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                           ' the sprites cut to the paper (x halved: over the border)
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 143 : Nx.Reg &H19, 32 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
uy = Scene.GROUND - 31
hiscore = 20000
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANT
  Tiles.Rect 4, 6, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCAN
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANG
  ShowScore
  ShowLives
  Tiles.Text 20, 4, "WAVE " & Right$("0" & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 2)
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, "SCORE " & Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(score)), 7)
  scoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
  For k = 0 To 4
    If k < lives Then Tiles.Put 31 + k, 4, GfxData.T_LIFE Else Tiles.Put 31 + k, 4, GfxData.T_HUD
  Next
End Sub

' a message across the middle for t frames (0: until the next)
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, y, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (32 - Len(longText)) \ 2, y, longText
  If t Then msgT = t
End Sub

Sub ClearMessages()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 8, 32, 20, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer, cx As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50 : Spr.Show
  Bul.Reset : Bul.Show
  wave = 1 : lives = 3 : score = 0
  Hud
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, "HI " & Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(hiscore)), 7)
  Message "ATTACK OF THE", 9, 0
  Message "CYBORG UNICORNS", 10, 0
  Message "STOP THEM BEFORE THE GATE", 12, 0
  Message "QAOP / SXZC / 5678  FLY", 14, 0
  Message "SPACE  FIRE", 15, 0
  Message "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", 26, 0
  ' a unicorn walking by while you wait
  For k = 0 To NU - 1
    uon(k) = 0
  Next
  uon(0) = 1 : ux(0) = 300 * 8 : uhp(0) = 1 : umax(0) = 1 : uspd(0) = 3 : ufl(0) = 0
  camX = 0 : y = 0
  Do
    camX = camX + 1
    If camX >= WORLD - 256 Then camX = 0
    ux(0) = ux(0) - uspd(0)
    If ux(0) \ 8 < camX - 40 Then ux(0) = (camX + 320) * 8
    DrawUnicorn 0
    Frame
    Scene.Scroll camX
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    y = y + 1
    If y = 30 Then Message "PRESS SPACE", 27, 0
    If y = 60 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 27, 32, 1, 0 : y = 0
  Loop Until FireDown()
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 8, 32, 20, 0
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, -6, 15, 25, 0
End Sub

Function FireDown() As Integer
  FireDown = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  score = 0 : lives = 3 : wave = 1 : over = 0
  Do
    WaveRun
    If over Then Exit Do
    wave = wave + 1
  Loop
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  Message "GAME OVER", 14, 0
  For k = 1 To 250
    Frame
    Sfx.Update
    If k > 50 And FireDown() Then Exit For
  Next
  ClearMessages
End Sub

' one wave: until every unicorn is down, or the last ship is lost
Sub WaveRun()
  Dim n As Integer, b As Long
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50
  Bul.Reset
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    bt(k) = 0
  Next
  n = 3 + wave
  If n > NU Then n = NU
  For k = 0 To NU - 1
    uon(k) = 0
    If k < n Then
      uon(k) = 1
      ux(k) = (WORLD - 120 - k * 190 - Rnd(60)) * 8
      umax(k) = 16 + wave * 4 : uhp(k) = umax(k)
      uspd(k) = 2 + wave \ 2 + Rnd(2)
      If uspd(k) > 7 Then uspd(k) = 7
      ufire(k) = 100 + Rnd(100)
      ufl(k) = 0
    End If
  Next
  remain = n
  sx = 80 * 8 : sy = 100 : svx = 0 : face = 1 : alive = 1 : inv = 100 : deadT = 0 : cool = 0
  camX = 0 : pan = 0
  Hud
  Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 13, 120
  Message Trim$(Str$(n)) & " CYBORG UNICORNS COMING", 15, 120
  clearT = 0
  Do
    PlayerMove
    Camera
    Unicorns
    Booms
    If alive Then Bul.Step sx \ 8 - camX, sy, pan Else Bul.Step 0, 0, pan
    If alive And inv = 0 Then
      If Bul.Hit() Then Die
    End If
    DrawShip
    Scanner
    If scoreDirty And (frames And 3) = 0 Then ShowScore
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then ClearMessages
    End If
    Frame
    Scene.Scroll camX
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If alive = 0 And deadT = 0 And lives = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
    If remain = 0 Then
      clearT = clearT + 1
      If clearT = 30 Then
        b = wave * 1000
        AddScore b
        Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)) & " CLEARED", 13, 0
        Message "BONUS " & Trim$(Str$(b)), 15, 0
        Sfx.Play 0, 100, -2, 15, 50, 0
      End If
      If clearT > 170 Then ClearMessages : Exit Sub
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  scoreDirty = 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the jet
Sub PlayerMove()
  Dim j0 As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer
  If alive = 0 Then
    If deadT > 0 Then
      deadT = deadT - 1
      If deadT = 0 And lives > 0 Then
        alive = 1 : inv = 120 : sy = 100 : svx = 0
        sx = (camX + 128) * 8
      End If
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyC) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyUp) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyDown) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If mx <> 0 Then
    face = mx
    svx = svx + mx * 3
    If svx > 40 Then svx = 40
    If svx < -40 Then svx = -40
  Else
    If svx > 0 Then svx = svx - 1
    If svx < 0 Then svx = svx + 1
  End If
  sx = sx + svx
  If sx < 64 Then sx = 64 : svx = 0
  If sx > (WORLD - 8) * 8 Then sx = (WORLD - 8) * 8 : svx = 0
  sy = sy + my * 2
  If sy < YTOP Then sy = YTOP
  If sy > YLOW Then sy = YLOW
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If FireDown() And cool = 0 Then
    Bul.Shot sx \ 8 - camX + face * 8, sy + 1, face * 14 + svx \ 8
    cool = 5
    Sfx.Play 0, 30, 4, 10, 4, 0
  End If
  If inv > 0 Then inv = inv - 1
End Sub

' the view: the jet a third of the way in from the side it's leaving
Sub Camera()
  Dim want As Integer, was As Integer
  was = camX
  If face > 0 Then want = sx \ 8 - 88 Else want = sx \ 8 - 168
  If want < 0 Then want = 0
  If want > WORLD - 256 Then want = WORLD - 256
  If want > camX + 7 Then
    camX = camX + 7
  ElseIf want < camX - 7 Then
    camX = camX - 7
  Else
    camX = want
  End If
  pan = camX - was
End Sub

Sub DrawShip()
  Dim fl As Integer
  If alive = 0 Or (inv And 4) <> 0 Then
    Spr.Hide SP_SHIP
  Else
    If face < 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX Else fl = 0
    Spr.Put SP_SHIP, sx \ 8 - camX + 24, sy + 24, GfxData.S_SHIP + ((frames \ 3) And 1), fl
  End If
  If Bul.Sparked() Then Sfx.Play 1, 8, 2, 9, 3, 1
End Sub

Sub Die()
  alive = 0 : deadT = 100 : lives = lives - 1 : ShowLives
  Boom sx \ 8, sy, 1
  Boom sx \ 8 - 10, sy - 6, 0
  Boom sx \ 8 + 10, sy + 6, 0
  k = Bul.Clear()
  Spr.Hide SP_SHIP
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 70, 1
  Sfx.Play 1, 300, 10, 15, 50, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the unicorns
Sub Unicorns()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, h As Integer, a As Integer, sp As Integer
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uon(n) Then
      ux(n) = ux(n) - uspd(n)
      x = ux(n) \ 8 - camX                 ' its middle on the screen
      ' through the gate
      If ux(n) < 0 Then
        Message "ONE BROKE THROUGH THE GATE!", 14, 120
        ux(n) = (WORLD - 60) * 8
        If alive Then Die Else lives = lives - 1 : ShowLives
        If lives < 0 Then lives = 0
      End If
      ' shot
      h = Bul.Hits(n)
      If h > 0 Then
        uhp(n) = uhp(n) - h
        If (frames And 3) = 0 Then ufl(n) = 1
        AddScore 10 * h
        Sfx.Play 1, 60, -4, 11, 4, 0
        If uhp(n) <= 0 Then
          Kill n
        End If
      End If
      If uon(n) Then
        If x > 8 And x < 248 Then Bul.Box n, x, uy + 4, 26, 26 Else Bul.Off n
        ' its horn fires at you
        ufire(n) = ufire(n) - 1
        If ufire(n) <= 0 Then
          a = 130 - wave * 8
          If a < 45 Then a = 45
          ufire(n) = a + Rnd(50)
          If alive And x > 16 And x < 240 Then
            sp = 18 + wave * 2
            If sp > 40 Then sp = 40
            a = Bul.Aim(x - 26, uy - 28, sx \ 8 - camX, sy)
            Bul.Fire x - 26, uy - 28, a, sp, GfxData.S_BOLT, 0
            If wave >= 3 Then
              Bul.Fire x - 26, uy - 28, a - 12, sp, GfxData.S_BOLT, 0
              Bul.Fire x - 26, uy - 28, a + 12, sp, GfxData.S_BOLT, 0
            End If
            Sfx.Play 2, 120, -6, 12, 14, 0
          End If
        End If
        ' running into it
        If alive And inv = 0 Then
          If Abs(sx \ 8 - camX - x) < 26 And Abs(sy - uy) < 28 Then Die
        End If
        DrawUnicorn n
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' unicorn n's four sprites (two by two, each drawn twice the size), coloured by its damage
Sub DrawUnicorn(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, f As Integer, fl As Integer, ci As Integer, cj As Integer, px As Integer, slot As Integer
  slot = SP_UNI + n * 4
  x = ux(n) \ 8 - camX
  If x < -40 Or x > 300 Then
    Spr.HideRange slot, 4
    Exit Sub
  End If
  f = ((ux(n) \ 8) \ 5) And 3
  fl = Spr.Scale2 Or (Spr.Pal * ((umax(n) - uhp(n)) * 4 \ (umax(n) + 1)))
  If ufl(n) > 0 Then ufl(n) = ufl(n) - 1 : fl = Spr.Scale2 Or (Spr.Pal * 4)
  For cj = 0 To 1
    For ci = 0 To 1
      px = x - 32 + ci * 32 + 32
      If px < 0 Or px > 319 Then
        Spr.Hide slot + cj * 2 + ci
      Else
        Spr.Put slot + cj * 2 + ci, px, uy - 32 + cj * 32 + 32, GfxData.S_UNICORN + f * 4 + cj * 2 + ci, fl
      End If
    Next
  Next
End Sub

Sub Kill(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer
  uon(n) = 0 : remain = remain - 1
  Bul.Off n
  Spr.HideRange SP_UNI + n * 4, 4
  x = ux(n) \ 8
  Boom x, uy, 1
  Boom x - 18, uy - 16, 1
  Boom x + 16, uy - 6, 0
  Boom x - 6, uy + 18, 0
  AddScore 500 * wave
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 50, 1
  Sfx.Play 0, 40, 8, 14, 40, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- explosions
Sub Boom(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal big As Integer)
  bx(bnext) = x : by(bnext) = y : bt(bnext) = 16 : bbig(bnext) = big
  bnext = (bnext + 1) And 7
End Sub

Sub Booms()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer
  For n = 0 To NB - 1
    If bt(n) > 0 Then
      bt(n) = bt(n) - 1
      x = bx(n) - camX
      If bt(n) = 0 Or x < -16 Or x > 272 Then
        Spr.Hide SP_BOOM + n
      ElseIf bbig(n) Then
        Spr.Put SP_BOOM + n, x + 16, by(n) + 16, GfxData.S_BOOM + (15 - bt(n)) \ 4, Spr.Scale2
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_BOOM + n, x + 24, by(n) + 24, GfxData.S_BOOM + (15 - bt(n)) \ 4, 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the scanner
' the whole plain in 256 pixels (8 to 1): you, the unicorns, the part on screen
Sub Scanner()
  Dim n As Integer
  Spr.Put SP_WIN, camX \ 8 + 32, 42, GfxData.S_WINDOW, Spr.Scale2X
  If alive Then
    Spr.Put SP_DOTME, sx \ 64 + 24, 12 + (sy - 36) * 14 \ 130 + 24, GfxData.S_DOT, 0
  Else
    Spr.Hide SP_DOTME
  End If
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uon(n) Then
      Spr.Put SP_DOTU + n, ux(n) \ 64 + 24, 12 + (uy - 36) * 14 \ 130 + 24, GfxData.S_DOT + 1, 0
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_DOTU + n
    End If
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Bul.cls
files.text:
' Bul - the bullet engine: 60 enemy bullets and 18 player shots as hardware sprites 50-127,
' moved, checked and drawn in Z80 every frame. (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' This copy is for ATTACK OF THE CYBORG UNICORNS: the play area is the whole 256 x 192 paper and
' scrolls sideways. Coordinates are the paper's (0-255 across, 0-191 down; Show adds 24 to put
' them on the sprites' screen). Positions are centres.
' Enemy bullets move in 1/256ths of a pixel (an angle and a speed: Fire); they go when they leave
' the play area (rows 36-187 - the HUD is above). Step tells you if one is on the player (within
' 5 pixels of the centre).
' Shots fly sideways (vx pixels a frame: their speed over the ground) and hit boxes: up to 24
' targets Main puts down each frame (Box n, x, y, half width, half height), each counting its hits
' until Hits(n) reads them.
' Step's pan is how far the view moved this frame (pixels, + right): everything flying moves the
' other way with the ground.
' A frame:  Bul.Step px, py, pan  (moves all, writes the sprites' table)
'           Frame : Bul.Show (the table to the hardware)
Option Explicit

Private eb(599) As Byte           ' 60 bullets x 10: x (lo, hi), y (lo, hi), vx, vy, pattern (255 = none), palette
Private sh(71) As Byte            ' 18 shots x 4: x, y, vx, on
Private bx(143) As Byte           ' 24 boxes x 6: on, x, y, half width, half height, hits
Private att(389) As Byte          ' 78 sprites x 5
Private hitF As Integer, live As Integer, spk As Integer, spkX As Integer, spkY As Integer
Private cnt As Integer, ang As Integer, tmp As Integer, vx As Integer, vy As Integer
Private sa3 As Integer, sa4 As Integer, six As Integer
Private atn(16) As Integer

' Init shotPattern: everything cleared, the shots' sprite pattern
Public Sub Init(ByVal shotPattern As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  sa3 = &HC0 Or (shotPattern \ 2)
  sa4 = &H80 Or ((shotPattern And 1) * 64)
  ' atan(k / 16) in 256ths of a turn
  atn(0) = 0 : atn(1) = 3 : atn(2) = 5 : atn(3) = 8 : atn(4) = 10 : atn(5) = 12 : atn(6) = 15 : atn(7) = 17
  atn(8) = 19 : atn(9) = 21 : atn(10) = 23 : atn(11) = 25 : atn(12) = 26 : atn(13) = 28 : atn(14) = 29
  atn(15) = 31 : atn(16) = 32
  tmp = Sines()
  Reset
End Sub

' Reset: no bullets, no shots, no boxes
Public Sub Reset()
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
rs_b:
            ld (hl), 255
            add hl, de
            djnz rs_b
            ld hl, {sh}
            ld b, 72
rs_s:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_s
            ld hl, {bx}
            ld b, 144
rs_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_x
            ld hl, {att}
            ld b, 78
rs_a:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear(): every enemy bullet gone (a bomb, a boss beaten): how many there were
Public Function Clear() As Integer
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld bc, 60 * 256
cl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, cl_n
            ld (hl), 255
            inc c
cl_n:
            add hl, de
            djnz cl_lp
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fire x, y, a, spd, pat, pal: an enemy bullet from x, y going way a (0-255: 0 down, 64 right,
' 128 up, 192 left) at spd sixteenths of a pixel a frame, sprite pattern pat in palette pal
Public Sub Fire(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ang}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_s1 + 1), a
            ld (fi_s2 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_p + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (fi_c + 1), a
            ld hl, {eb} + 8         ; a free one
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
fi_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, fi_got
            add hl, de
            djnz fi_find
            jp fi_done
fi_got:
            ld de, -8
            add hl, de
            ld ({tmp}), hl
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vx = sin(a) * spd / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n1
            inc h
fi_n1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p1
            neg
fi_p1:
            ld d, a
fi_s1:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v1:
            ld ({vx}), de
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vy = sin(a + 64) * spd / 8
            add a, 64
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n2
            inc h
fi_n2:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p2
            neg
fi_p2:
            ld d, a
fi_s2:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v2:
            ld ({vy}), de
            ld hl, ({tmp})
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_y:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vx})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vy})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
fi_p:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
fi_c:
            ld (hl), 0
fi_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Shot x, y, vx: a player shot from x, y, flying vx pixels a frame over the ground (-20 .. 20)
Public Sub Shot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal sx As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_v + 1), a
            ld hl, {sh} + 3
            ld de, 4
            ld b, 18
so_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, so_got
            add hl, de
            djnz so_find
            jr so_done
so_got:
            ld (hl), 1
            dec hl
so_v:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
so_y:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
so_x:
            ld (hl), 0
so_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Box n, x, y, hw, hh: target n (0-23) this frame, centred at x, y, hw across and hh down from
' the centre to its edges
Public Sub Box(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal hw As Integer, ByVal hh As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; HL = bx + n * 6
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 1
            inc hl
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Off n: target n gone (its hits kept until Hits reads them)
Public Sub Off(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Sub

' Hits(n): the shots that hit target n since the last Hits(n)
Public Function Hits(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx} + 5
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (hl), 0
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Step px, py, pan: every bullet and shot moved (the view moved pan pixels), checked, put in the
' sprites' table
Public Sub Step(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer, ByVal pan As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_px + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_py + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_pan + 1), a
            ld (ss_pan + 1), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            xor a
            ld ({hitF}), a
            ld ({live}), a
            ld ({spk}), a
            ld ix, {eb}
            ld de, {att}
            ld a, 60
            ld ({cnt}), a
st_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 255
            jp z, st_free
            ld c, a                 ; the pattern
            ld a, (ix + 0)          ; x += vx - pan
            add a, (ix + 4)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            adc a, (ix + 5)
st_pan:
            sub 0
            ld (ix + 1), a
            cp 4
            jr c, st_kill
            cp 252
            jr nc, st_kill
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; y += vy
            add a, (ix + 6)
            ld (ix + 2), a

            add a, 24

            ld a, (ix + 9)

            ld a, c

            rrca
            rrca

            ld (de), a

            sub 0

            cp 4

            ld a, (hl)

            jr z, ss_skip6

            ld a, (ix + 0)

            inc hl

            inc hl

            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz ss_box

            ld a, l
            add a, 6
            ld l, a

ss_nc:

            ld a, (ix + 0)

            ld (de), a
            inc de
            sbc a, a
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; flying left: mirrored
            and #80
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            or b
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, ({sa3})
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, ({sa4})
            ld (de), a

            ld (ix + 3), 0
ss_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a

            xor a

            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix

' Aim(x, y, tx, ty): the way (0-255, as Fire's) from x, y to tx, ty
Public Function Aim(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal tx As Integer, ByVal ty As Integer) As Integer
  Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, ax As Integer, ay As Integer, t As Integer
  dx = tx - x : dy = ty - y
  ax = Abs(dx) : ay = Abs(dy)
  If ax = 0 And ay = 0 Then
    Aim = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  If ax <= ay Then
    t = atn(ax * 16 \ ay)
  Else
    t = 64 - atn(ay * 16 \ ax)
  End If
  If dy >= 0 Then
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = t Else Aim = (256 - t) And 255
  Else
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = 128 - t Else Aim = 128 + t
  End If
End Function
